intro: Bhutan earns most of its money by selling hydropower to India.

chapters.title: Hydropower
text: Fast mountain rivers drive power stations, and India buys most of the electricity.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Bhutan charges visitors a daily fee to keep tourism small and pay for conservation. It is also building Gelephu Mindfulness City, a new economic zone.

cardGroups.title: Made in Bhutan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Bhutan makes and sells to the world.
